interface.shortDescription: Publish files as a web link
interface.longDescription:
Publish pages and text files from ChatGPT as a public DropZoom link, and look up links you already have.

Get connected
The DropZoom connection window lets you create an account or sign in, add a passkey if needed, and choose what ChatGPT may do. You stay in the same setup flow. After returning to ChatGPT, finish with the pairing code it shows you. You can remove the connection in DropZoom at any time.

Publish with a preview
ChatGPT shows you which files would go live and asks before publishing. Every new link is public: anyone with the address can read it. Files are checked for secrets and malware before publication. ChatGPT creates new links; it cannot change or delete existing ones.

Look up your work
See your links, their files and versions, and visitor comments if you allow that access.

Limits
Publish text written in the conversation, up to 20 files, 256 KiB per file and 1 MiB in total. Files uploaded to the conversation cannot be published yet. Keep private information out of public links.

DropZoom is a product of Grey Arc Ltd. Privacy, terms and acceptable use policies are linked from dropzoom.link.
